chat.t: {player}, Master! Where are you right now?
I actually have a favor to ask you!
Oh, don't be like that!
{player}, it has to be you, Master!
It's a bit too embarrassing to ask Freya or Theta...
Uuu... What do you take me for, {player}?
Of course I get shy when the situation calls for it!
Anyway, you must keep this a complete secret from the other girls, okay?
The truth is, I'm a bit clumsy, so I lose things quite often.
Seriously, please listen to me until the end!
Anyway, so I lost something while fighting in the Panoticon the other day.
My favor is for you to help me find it.
Mmm... asking so bluntly like that...
{player}, you're a pervert, Master...!
Did you really intend to make me say it myself...?
Fine... if you insist...
The thing I lost... is actually...
My underwear...
Kyaaa! ><

o: Did you even wear underwear in the first place?

chat.t: Fufufu.
If you're curious, step right up!
{player}, thank you for your hard work today, Master!
At least we finished putting up all the flyers!
Fufufu, now we just have to wait for someone to contact us!

o: How on earth do you lose the underwear you're currently wearing?

chat.t: I told you, I'm just a bit clumsy... T_T

o: How is that even an explanation?!

chat.t: Hmm... is there something strange about that?
Even Freya and Theta lose theirs once in a while.
Though I suppose I lose mine a bit more often than those two...
Aww... people like that do exist!
No one can be completely perfect!

lines.t: Hideout
Oh my.
I'm back.
Welcome back, {player}!
Fufufu, I didn't expect you to arrive so quickly.
I was just killing time nearby anyway.
Really? I'm so glad!
It seems the timing was just perfect.
It's only been three minutes since I sent the MochiTalk...
Forget the trivial details, let's get down to business.
Fufufu, very well.
My request is exactly as I mentioned earlier.
I'd like you to help me find my... precious item.
You mean your underwear.
Aww, if you say it so directly...
It makes me so embarrassed...
{player}, you are so mean, Master...
More importantly...
Did you actually wear underwear normally?
So does that mean you're... wearing them right now?
Ah, where are you looking!
Seriously... not here...
At least wait until we're somewhere with a better atmosphere...!
This is important, so just tell me already.
Fufufu, fine.
The answer to your question is...
A secret! ♡
I'm leaving.
Ah! Time out, time out!
Okay! Let's do this instead.
If you help me find it, I'll reward you.
{player}, by granting you any single wish you want!
...Anything? Really?
Yes! Absolutely anything!
An opportunity like this doesn't come around very often, you know?
From checking whether I'm wearing underwear right now...
To doing this or that thing you always imagined doing with me...
Ah... even things like that...
Seriously..., if {player} can't hold back anymore, then I'll...
...I'm honestly starting to wonder what the hell you're imagining.
Let's just go.
...Hmm.
It's great that you're motivated, but...
There's one tiny little problem.
I don't actually remember where I lost it...
What? Then how are we supposed to find it?
Fufufu, that's why we need this.
Tada! ♡
Lumina held something out.
This is...
Looking for Missing Underwear'?
Fufufu, yes. It's a missing flyer I made!
Searching without any clues would be too daunting, wouldn't it?
So, we post these in suspicious places and wait for someone to contact us!
How about that? A flawless plan, right?
A missing underwear flyer...
I've never seen anything like this in my entire life.
Oh my, does that mean...
I took your... first time, {player}?
Ah... o-of course, I'm extremely happy...
But I wonder if it's okay for me to just accept something like that...
In that case... I will give my first time to you, {player}... ♡
Ah, wait up! Let's go together!

Thus, I spent the entire day searching for places
where Lumina might have dropped her underwear.

In the end, we couldn't find them,
but we returned after posting every single flyer we brought.

chat.t: {player}, Master!
It's here!
Someone contacted us!
The message about finding my underwear!
Well, they didn't exactly find it, but...
Anyway, I didn't actually expect anyone to contact us.
You remember the flyers we were posting earlier, right?
It seems someone saw one of them!
Fufufu, the flyers really worked!

o: Didn't you just say you didn't expect anyone to contact us?

chat.t: Let's not fuss over trivial details!
Anyway!
The person who messaged said they didn't see it themselves,
But instead, they referred me to an information broker who might be of help!
So I plan on heading there tomorrow. That's fine with you, right?

o: Don't tell me you actually believe them?
The words of someone who responded to a flyer about missing underwear?

chat.t: Oh, come on.
Who would lie about something like this?
You worry too much, haha.
See you tomorrow then!

lines.t: The next day, unable to withstand Lumina's badgering, I headed to the meeting spot.

I couldn't believe we were actually taking someone seriously
who responded to a missing underwear flyer...
In Front of Humanitas Station
Ah, {player}!
Fufufu, good morning!
The weather is lovely today, perfect for walking around.
Now... are you ready to help me find my precious item?
Don't forget your promise to grant me any wish.
Since it's come to this, I'm going to make you do something incredible.
Y-You're going to make me do something incredible...?
O-Oh dear...
Did I make too reckless of a promise...?
W-What is going to happen to me now...?
A-Alright, joke's over!
L-Let's head out!
Secluded Alley
Are you sure this is the place?
Hmm... it should be...
Who are you guys-plu?
Pururu (I've never seen you guys before.)
The 'Underwear Collector' is a Flurry...?
Underwear Collector'?
I understand a standard collector, but what the hell is a gatherer?
Puru? Pururupu (Hmm? They've heard about us from somewhere.)
Do you know us-plu?
Well, yes... I suppose so. Though I only found out about you recently.
An Underwear Collector who supposedly lives in some dark alleyway of Humanitas.
Rumor has it they gather every piece of underwear dropped on this land...
We came because we have business with that legendary existence.
Fufufu... although I never imagined you'd be a Flurry.
People will call literally anything a legend.
This guy knows a thing or two for a human-plu!
Puru...! Pu, pururu! (A legendary existence...! That's right, that's exactly who we are!)
Well-informed human, what business do you have with us-plu?
Actually, we're currently looking for a lost piece of underwear!
But I can't quite remember where I lost it...
I heard that an Underwear Collector might know something, so I came looking!
I see, you're a clever human-plu!
Puru, purupuru! (You've come to the right place, smart human!)
It's certainly possible that what you're looking for is among our gathered goods-plu!
However...!
It's already become our gathered item, so it's ours-plu!
Purupuru! (If you want it, you have to pay a fair price!)
A f-fair price...?
This is a hassle. If we just beat them up a bit, won't they hand it over?
N-No violence-plu!!
Pururu!! (A bad human is threatening us!!)
Come now, let's save that as a last resort!
Purupuru...! (The pink human is also a violent human-plu...!)
F-Fine-plu! Then I'll let you trade it if you pass a test instead-plu!
That's basically the same thing.
But a test sounds like it could be fun, don't you think?
What is this test you speak of?
Pupupu! The test is going to be quite difficult-plu!
We do not treat a single piece of gathered underwear carelessly-plu!
Pu! Purupuru! (That's right! Because that's a gatherer's pride!)
We analyze everything without exception, including the fabric, weight, sewing method, and wearing time-plu!
Only by thoroughly investigating each one like that can we truly say we have gathered underwear with meaning-plu!!
You're literally just a bunch of perverts.
Human! In that case, do you remember what kind of underwear you lost and why it's so important-plu?!
If you remember this, you pass...
Of course! You see, that underwear is...
The underwear I was wearing when I broke out of the Panoticon!
Puru...?! (She actually remembers...!?)
Th-The Panoticon-plu?!
You remember the weirdest details.
Yes, the memories of that day are still vivid.
Our breakout of the Panoticon... It started with your grand declaration, {player}...
All the way until everything was wrapped up and we walked leisurely out the main gate...
It's a historical piece of underwear that was with me through every single moment, you know?
Of course, it suddenly vanished at some point after that...
But that's how truly precious it is to me. So...
I absolutely must find that underwear.
H-Human... I'm so moved-plu...!
Purupu! (This is a human with pride!)
You passed the test-plu! You have the right to see-plu!
Puru, pupurupu! (Human, prepare to be amazed by our gatherer's goods!)
Wow!
One, two, three...
...Is this it?
Hey! You call yourselves gatherers and you only have three?!
And you call yourselves a legendary existence?
Th-This is really all we have-plu!
Pupurupu! (Even finding three is a lot!)
Besides, it doesn't look like my underwear is among them...
We never said we had yours-plu!
Purupu! (We said it was possible we did!)
I bet if we search you, we'll find more.
Puru! Puru! (No violence! No violence!)
Th-The Panoticon-plu!!
...What?
There's a massive amount of underwear in the Panoticon-plu!
Puru! Rupupuru! (That's right! It will definitely be there-plu!)
Uh, um... what?
In the Panoticon... there's a massive amount...?
Tell me more about that.
Humanitas Park
Phew!
Thank you for your hard work today, {player}!
This turned into a much bigger deal than I thought.
Yes, I never expected the Panoticon's name to come up...
Besides, to think there's a mountain of underwear in the Panoticon's Lost and Found...
Do you think what those Flurries said is true?
Well, we won't know until we go see for ourselves.
That's true!
...Huh? Are you coming with me, {player}?
Since it's come to this, we might as well see it through to the end.
Thank you, {player}.
*Sob*, to think you'd work so hard to help me...
I will definitely repay this debt.
Even if... I have to offer you my b-body and soul...
Actually, there is something I need you to do.
W-What would that be...?
I'm hungry, buy me lunch.
Y-Yes...
So... where should we go...?
After grabbing some snacks with Lumina around the nearby shopping street, we returned to the Hideout.

chat.t: {player}, {player}.
Are you free tomorrow?
I'm thinking of starting soon.
Namely, the Panoticon Lost and Found Infiltration Operation!

o: But how are you planning on getting in?
Our faces are already known there.

chat.t: Fufufu, that's why I researched an infiltration route for this mission.
We'll sneak in through an unused ventilation shaft, which apparently connects to the first floor.
Since the Lost and Found is also on the first floor, we shouldn't get caught right away!

o: And what if we do get caught?

chat.t: Oh, come on, you know!
Even though we couldn't find my underwear in the end...
It was still fun, fufufu.
I'll grant you the single wish I promised.
I do feel a bit bad for causing you so much trouble.
Now...
{player}, what is it you want from me, Master...?

o: From now on, never make a single dirty joke ever again.

chat.t: Ah! Please, anything but that...
Excuse me???
What do you mean by that?
Uh... are you serious?

o: I've never been more serious in my entire life.

chat.t: Um... could you wish for something else instead?
That is the only pleasure I have in life...
Actually, that's basically telling me to die!
I'll do literally anything else, okay?
{player}, Master?
{player}, Master?

lines.t: Inside the Panoticon Air Vents
U-Um... {player}?
You must never... ne-ever look ahead, okay...?
I won't look, so just hurry up and keep moving.
Ah... you really shouldn't...
Sigh...
Phew, looks like the coast is clear.
You know the way, right?
Hehe, of course!
Just follow my lead!
Panoticon Lost and Found
{player}, Master, over here!
Hehe, our infiltration operation is a success!
I can't believe I'm back here again...
This place isn't so bad once you get used to it.
The maids take care of your every need, and they serve meals right on time.
{player}, well, in your case, Master... it was a rather unique situation.
I was briefly tempted by the Panoticon, but now I don't really care.
I would've gotten bored of it quickly anyway.
...Hehe,  actually, I feel the same way.
It is certainly comfortable, but it is far from exciting.
That is why that day was so meaningful to me.
Just thinking about it makes me breathless, and my legs shake so much that I can barely even stand...
Oh, by "that day," I mean the day we broke out of the Panoticon.
I know, dummy.
Hehe!
Now, let's start looking for...
Huh...?
You said we wouldn't get caught so quickly.
Oops.
Masters! Y-You shouldn't be in here!
If you have lost something, please ask the other maids...  um...  to...
I feel like I've seen the two of you somewhere...
...Eeeek?! Y-You are those escap—mmmph!!
Now, let's keep quiet for a second!
Hehe, don't resist.
...I feel like I've seen this somewhere before.
Mmmph! Mmm-mmmph!!
We really don't want to make a big scene, you see.
We'll just leave quietly.
Nod your head if you understand.
(Nod)
Hehe, what a good girl.
Then we'll be heading back...
Oh my.
...Hehehe.
This is as far as you go, naughty Masters!
Is a maid allowed to block a master's path?
Ugh... th-that might be true, but...
There is a massive bonus on your heads!
Anyone who catches you will...
be named Maid of the Month!
And what do you get for that?
You get a paid vacation, dinner money, and you're exempt from food waste duty!
...Is that it?
U-Ugh... do you have any idea how huge of a benefit that is?!
Anyway...! Please come with us quietly!!
{player}, Master.
Yeah?
It seems a confrontation is unavoidable...
...Hehe.
Are you ready to break out once again?
This time, it's a joint operation for just the two of us!
...Sigh.
Humanitas Alley
...We should be safe here.
Haa, haa...
Ngh... haa, ah... hng...
You sure are dedicated to your bit.
Oh, come on, I'm really exhausted!
I don't think my first <ruby="escape">experience</ruby> was this exhausting...
As expected, on my own I can't quite handle {player}...
More importantly, something just crossed my mind.
After we escaped, we briefly kidnapped someone, didn't we?
Ah, I guess we did, didn't we?
I'm pretty sure she was a maid... or wait, maybe a police officer...
Do you remember? When we tried to gag her.
Hmm, back then, we used...  a suitable piece of cloth we had...  to...
Aaaah!!!!!
So that really was your underwear.
Ah... ahaha, I-I guess it was.
What did you tell the Flurries again? Something about historical underwear?
Ehehe♡
Hehe! Haha!!
Ah, what are we even doing...
...Shall we go grab something to eat now?
That's my line.
Hehe, I can read you like an open book now, {player}.
Of course, my treat this time too.
It is not much of an exchange, but...  could you grant me one wish?
I'll hear it out first.
As long as it doesn't cost me money.
...Hehe. It is nothing like that.
My wish is... hehehe...  it is none other than...!
To have a fun day every single day!  Just like today!
...That's it?  That's surprisingly anti-climactic.
Hehehe, shouldn't I show you a different side of my charm every now and then?
Anyway... that is why I am really glad I met you, {player}.
Of course, it was fun when the three of us—with Freya and Theta—spent time together,
but now I have another new source of joy.
So... please keep helping me with my wish, okay?
